preToolUse.bash: for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py" copilot; fi; done; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: $r = if ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; foreach ($p in 'python','py','python3') { if (Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $input | & $p "$r/scripts/guard.py" copilot; exit 0 } }; exit 0
